title: cloud-connection: install-local's own uninstall door (DELETE /marketplace/install-local/:id) bypasses the uninstall verb, so it asks no uninstall guard and writes no package audit row
body:
domain:server#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dLQEXWGsE2SZ3Qn5F

Filing gate: ① product defect, from the deliveries of #31232 (PR #31280, dev report 6713593306, finding 3) and #31186 (seat ruling A, dev note in its card thread). Read from code, not run. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (`handleUninstall`, ~l.3004).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `install-local uninstall deletePackage`, `install-local handleUninstall` → #31023 / #31183 (it already calls `protocol.runUninstallCleanups`), none on this gap.
reach: every uninstall through install-local's own door (`DELETE /marketplace/install-local/:id`); read from code.
class: a · type: Bug

## 维护者速读

本地安装的包有自己的卸载入口，它不走平台统一的卸载动作（`deletePackage`），只单独调用卸载后的清理。所以 #31232 加的“有规则依赖就拒绝卸载”的守卫和 #31186 加的“卸载写审计记录”对这个入口都不生效。

## What is wrong

- `handleUninstall` withdraws the package itself and then calls `protocol.runUninstallCleanups` (#31023), but never `protocol.deletePackage`.
- So it misses everything the verb now does before and after the delete: the pre-uninstall guards (#31232, PR #31280 — the dependent-rule refusal) and the package-uninstall audit row (#31186, written in the verb).

## Expected

- The door asks the same guards before its first write and writes the same audit row after a successful uninstall, through public protocol entry points (e.g. a public guard runner beside `runUninstallCleanups`, and the audit call reachable without `deletePackage`), or the door delegates to `deletePackage` outright. One verdict and one writer, never a copy in the door.
- Pins: install-local uninstall of a package whose field an active rule reads → refused with the verb's 409, nothing moved; CONTROL: proceeds without a dependent rule and writes one `package_uninstall` audit row.
- Lands after #31280 and #31186's PR (both claimed by `domain:server#4`).
